record.question: At which stage of the MCU procedure are images taken to assess for vesicoureteral reflux (VUR)?
options: Only during the initial filling of the bladder.
Before any contrast is administered (plain film).
During bladder filling and while the patient is micturating (urinating).
Only several hours after the procedure is completed.
record.explanation: Answer C: During bladder filling and while the patient is micturating (urinating).. VUR assessment requires imaging during filling and especially voiding; the listed combined phase is the best choice. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/safety-xray. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
